The AI's categories inherit its non-reference max-based binning and also label classes as `x_bin * 3 + y_bin`, so both the thresholding rule and label indexing differ.
4-c.code_correctness_justification: The code computes `projected_xy[0] * 3 + projected_xy[1]` and labels outputs accordingly.
